checked.target: AC1 d-pad/trigger mapping (src/input/gamepad.ts readGamepads, src/input/index.ts read)
checked.how: Traced PAD_BUTTON {left:14,right:15,gas:7,brake:6}. Button 14 held: dpad=-1, steer=clamp(0-0+-1)=-1, throttle/brake false, which equals the ArrowLeft result. Same check for 15, 7 and 6.
stickSteer: ±1 gives sign*min(1,0.85/0.85)=±1. 0.6 gives 0.529 and 0.4 gives 0.294, both in (0,1) with 0.6 larger. -0.6 gives exactly -0.529 (Math.sign times the same magnitude).
`!(m > 0.15)` returns 0 for 0.12, -0.1 and 0.15. read() then computes 0-0+0 = +0. At 0.2 the result is 0.05/0.85 = 0.0588, which is in (0, 0.1).

held() uses buttons[i].pressed, so value 0.1 with pressed false is not held. index.ts clamps keys+pad steer to −1…1. connectedPads skips null slots, disconnected pads, mapping !== 'standard', and a missing or non-function navigator.getGamepads. When it skips them, IDLE is returned and keys still work.

checked.target: AC5 A on start screen (game.ts confirmMenu/visibleMenu)
checked.how: At boot showMenu() unhides menuLayer and the start overlay (.ui-screen via dom.ts overlay). confirmMenu clicks the focused RACE button or the .ui-button--primary fallback, which calls onRace → startRace with PLAYER_CAR_COUNT (six cars), the same path as a tap.

checked.target: AC6 fresh-press across mode change and results
checked.how: createConfirmEdge keeps wasDown, and frame() polls it every frame before the mode check, so a held A gives no new edge in the race or on results. During the race no .ui-screen is visible (HUD, countdown and touch are not overlays), so even an edge does nothing. results-screen overlay focuses NEXT RACE, so release then press calls onNextRace → nextTrackId.

A only sets PadState.confirm, which read() never uses. visibleMenu returns null mid-race because the pause/results overlays are hidden and menuLayer is hidden, so nothing is clicked and paused is unchanged. While paused the loop is stopped, which matches the stated out-of-scope pause screen.

Every claim maps to the code traced above: stick analogue, d-pad full, RT gas, LT brake/reverse (the brake input is the same one ArrowDown uses), resting stick gives 0, A on start and results, held A does not repeat. I found no claim the build fails to meet.
